import zipfile,re,os
from pypdf import PdfReader
x=zipfile.ZipFile('Daniel_Masona_CV.docx').read('word/document.xml').decode('utf8')
paras=re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',x,flags=re.S)
t=[''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>',p)) for p in paras]
t=[s for s in t if s.strip()]
i=next(k for k,s in enumerate(t) if s.startswith('DIP'))
print('\n'.join(t[i-1:i+6]))
print('--- skills tools line:', next(s for s in t if s.startswith('Testing')))
r=PdfReader(os.environ['TEMP']+'/cvout/Daniel_Masona_CV.pdf')
print('pages:', len(r.pages), '| page 2 starts:', r.pages[1].extract_text().split(chr(10))[0] if len(r.pages)>1 else '-')
